children: Macy’s reported second-quarter 2026 results with net sales of $4.9 billion and comparable sales up 2.7%, driven by strength across its nameplates. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.62 and adjusted diluted EPS was $0.63, and the company raised its full-year 2026 guidance. Management reported improved gross margin and adjusted EBITDA expansion while deploying tariff refund proceeds into reinvestment and shareholder returns.
Net sales: $4.9 billion for the 13 weeks ended August 1, 2026 (up 1.1% versus prior year).
Gross profit: $2,018 million; gross margin rate 41.5% (increase of 180 basis points, including a 180 bp net tariff refund benefit).
Operating income: $244 million for the quarter.
Net income: GAAP net income $169 million for the quarter; diluted EPS $0.62.
Adjusted diluted EPS: $0.63 for the quarter (adjusted excludes certain items and reflects a $0.23 net tariff refund benefit in the quarter).
Adjusted EBITDA: $457 million, or 9.0% of total revenue, for the quarter.
Comparable sales rose 2.7% companywide; go-forward comparable sales increased 2.8% with all nameplates positive.
Macy’s nameplate comparable sales grew 1.1%, with the Reimagine 200 store cohort up 1.9%.
Bloomingdale’s delivered double-digit comparable sales growth (+11.3%) and reported its highest second-quarter sales volume in brand history.
Bluemercury comparable sales increased 6.2%, contributing to portfolio strength across channels.

Company received expected IEEPA tariff refunds totaling $116 million (including $98 million in Q2 and $18 million post-quarter) and is reinvesting the majority to support the Bold New Chapter strategy while returning capital via dividends and share repurchases.

title: Macy’s reports Q2 2026: Net sales $4.9B, GAAP EPS $0.62, adjusted EPS $0.63
